items.title: Eblen Rau Interview, 1974-05-27
items.q: We'd go somewhere and end up either in the Agnes Boathouse or the one next door to it that Bill Edgar had.

ctx.x: Did you ever go to Agnes Boathouse out there?

Hell yes. Agnes Boathouse was a monk and Rene Jelper. I used to play way back in the olden days. I know Daddy Knight was still living. Daddy Knight and Johnny Luther and one other person had the Boathouse there. We used to spend most weekends out there during the summertime. We'd go somewhere and end up either in the Agnes Boathouse or the one next door to it that Bill Edgar had. It was, remember old Fats, what's his name? Fats Daly, you remember him? I heard of him. He wasn't a musician but he was one of our…
There was a place out there to sleep, wasn't there? Yeah. You'd learn to play music late and stay over.
